about: Checks of the README Validation tables that the board status can prove. tools/make-validate-site.py joins them with the tables.
A row of the tables with no rule here is a manual check: the page gives it a tick and a note.
pass: all conditions must be true. fail: one true condition is enough. warn: all conditions true shows the text, and stores nothing.
A condition is [field, op, value], ["flag", NAME] or ["!flag", NAME]. NAME is SCRL_FLAG_<NAME> in main/scrl_status.h.
op: == != > >= < <= in. The value "$version" is PROJECT_VER of CMakeLists.txt.
Fields: info.fw info.board info.can info.chip, status.ok, rx.all rx.x3c2 rx.x39b rx.x370 rx.x257 rx.x318 rx.x129 rx.dropped,
tx.ok tx.failed tx.refused, busOff op rxPin up apState handsOn sent, set.enabled set.mode set.op_mode,
d.sent (ticks since the last sample of this connection), handsOn.recent (the higher hands-on level of this sample and the last one: the ticks clear the prompt).
A field with no data makes the condition unknown: no evidence.

warn: The new image is not confirmed. Confirm it in the control app in 10 minutes, or the board goes back to the old image.
An unconfirmed image runs now. For this check, do not confirm it, and wait 10 minutes.
Active is set, but this build names no CAN TX pin. The board stays in Listen-Only and sends nothing. Do nanoh2-pins-build first.
